tenant.environment_purpose_note: public.tenants has no environment-purpose column. Purpose Permanent Staging is documentary only.

profiles.tenantBindingNote: public.profiles has no tenant_id. Tenant binding is through acceptance_profiles.tenant_id and later project rows.

assignment.note: Schema does not require a tenant default. None of the three templates is marked is_default. No project or task assignment is created.

templates.name: Standard Data Throughput
templates.summary: Download 20 passing iterations at 10 Mbps AND upload 20 passing iterations at 1 Mbps. Voice directions are disabled and display N/A / NOT_EVALUATED. Missing applicable evidence is INCOMPLETE.

rules.description: Pass only when at least 20 completed DL iterations each reach at least 10 Mbps AND at least 20 completed UL iterations each reach at least 1 Mbps. Failed, missing, or incomplete iterations do not count as passes. Missing applicable evidence remains INCOMPLETE. Disabled voice directions display N/A / NOT_EVALUATED.

templates.name: Standard Voice Calls
templates.summary: MO 10 successful calls AND MT 10 successful calls. Data directions are disabled and display N/A / NOT_EVALUATED. Missing applicable evidence is INCOMPLETE.

rules.description: Pass only when at least 10 MO calls succeed AND at least 10 MT calls succeed. A successful call must also count as attempted. Disabled data directions display N/A / NOT_EVALUATED. Missing applicable evidence remains INCOMPLETE.

templates.name: Combined Data and Voice
templates.summary: DL 20 at 10 Mbps AND UL 20 at 1 Mbps AND MO 10 AND MT 10. All four families must pass. Missing applicable evidence is INCOMPLETE.

rules.description: Pass only when all four enabled requirements pass: 20 DL iterations at 10 Mbps, 20 UL iterations at 1 Mbps, 10 successful MO calls, and 10 successful MT calls. Absence of any enabled family remains INCOMPLETE.
